superseded_v1.defect: requiring every complete game of every player to stay in one partition collapses each connected player-game component and tests only for a zero-cut partition; that algebraic consequence is not a corpus-specific split-scale measurement
superseded_v1.replacement_scope: the v1 split-stop conclusion only; F0-D0 identities and all v1 bytes remain historical evidence

graph_measurement.edges: one behavior game; repeated player pairs are aggregated with game-count weight
graph_measurement.self_games: counted as games and player volume but excluded from opponent degree and topology edges
graph_measurement.component_order: descending player count, descending game count, component identity
graph_measurement.degree_quantiles: nearest-rank min, p01, p05, p10, p25, p50, p75, p90, p95, p99, max
graph_measurement.time_cut_semantics: pre is date less than cut; post starts on cut date

design_a.name: player cut with discarded cross-boundary games
design_a.algorithm: Louvain-community initialization followed by fixed-cardinality weighted Kernighan-Lin refinement
design_a.selection_within_target: minimum measured cut-game count, then membership identity

design_b.name: calendar time holdout
design_b.time_only: all games on or after the cut
design_b.strong_time_and_player_isolation: post-cut games for which both player keys are absent from every pre-cut game

design_c.name: decision-owner player partition
design_c.player_count_rounding: largest remainder with fixed partition order for ties
design_c.assignment: rank source player keys by domain-separated SHA-256 and assign exact player-count blocks
design_c.decision_owner: White owns even zero-based logical plies and Black owns odd plies
design_c.game_count: a partition counts a game when at least one logical ply is owned by one of its players
design_c.state_identity: repository ring16 canonical pre-decision NMM FEN
design_c.raw_replay_reason: F0-D0 retains move count but not per-ply predecessor states, so exact ring16 overlap requires strict replay of the manifest-bound raw game
overlap_rates: unique ring16 orbit overlap per partition
design_c.trajectory_leakage: cross-partition decision pairs from the same game, counted by exact logical-ply distance bucket regardless of ring16 equality
